subject: general
question: Which of the following books is authored by Indu Sundaresan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Feast of Roses**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The Feast of Roses:-**

 
 
• **It is a 2003 novel by Indian author Indu Sundaresan. (Hence option 3 is correct)**
 
• It is the sequel to her debut novel, The Twentieth Wife, and tells the story of Mehrunnisa, the twentieth and last wife of Mughal Emperor Jahangir, who came to be known as Empress Nur Jahan.
 
• The Feast of Roses is a lush and evocative novel that brings to life the opulence and intrigue of the Mughal court.
 
• It is also a story of love, betrayal, and ambition, as Mehrunnisa navigates the treacherous world of politics and power.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Secret of the Nagas:-**

 
 
• It is the second book in the Shiva Trilogy by Amish Tripathi.
 
• It is a fantasy novel set in the fictional land of Meluha and follows the story of Shiva, a Tibetan immigrant who is prophesied to be the destroyer of evil.
 
 
 
• **The One You Cannot Have:-**
 
 
• It is a novel by Preeti Shenoy about unrequited love and the challenges of finding true love.
 
• The story follows four characters: Aman, Shruti, Anjali, and Rishabh.
 
 
 
• **Ajaya: Rise of Kali:-**
 
 
• It is a novel by Amish Tripathi, the third and final book in the Shiva Trilogy.
 
• It is a fantasy novel set in the fictional land of Meluha, and follows the story of Shiva, a Tibetan immigrant who is prophesied to be the destroyer of evil.
